geometry_policy.rationale: Differentiated paired limbs, open raptorial armature, compound paddles and twelve separate trunk plates justify a practical medium/high-detail low-poly budget. Spend geometry on diagnostic profiles and limb separation, not dense micro-scales. Ceilings are fixed, not fill targets.

palette_note: Artistic, not inferred fossil color. Maker may adjust value modestly for legibility while retaining muted palette.
pose: neutral horizontal suspended aquatic pose; no ground-contact claim
topological_priorities: Separated articulated II and III grasping limbs with paired spines
Single broad xiphous telson without cercal blades
proportions_note: All unmeasured component dimensions and 3D volume are reconstruction choices. Exact limb positions and joint depth are maker design values constrained by brief.json.
